concepts.proposed_markdown: Bearer-authenticated `POST /v1/usage` reads aggregated usage across multiple customers and billable metrics between required time bounds and requested hourly, daily, or whole-period windows. Omitting optional `customer_ids` selects all customers; omitting optional `billable_metrics` selects all metrics. Each supplied metric selector requires UUID `id` and may request one `group_by.key`; omitted group values return all available values up to 200. The endpoint does not define metric calculation, archived-metric visibility, empty-selector behavior, group-value selection beyond 200, pricing, invoice equality, freshness, or accounting completeness. [[source-metronome-api-reference-usage-get-batched-usage-data]]
warnings: Keep batched aggregate retrieval distinct from metric creation, matching, calculation, and Product pricing or presentation configuration.
Do not infer omitted-body behavior from required properties inside the supplied payload schema.
The page does not define behavior for empty customer or metric arrays, archived metrics, or more than 200 available group values.

concepts.proposed_markdown: `POST /v1/usage` is a multi-customer, multi-billable-metric aggregate read for internal analytics, reports, trend monitoring, comparisons, and capacity planning. Required bounds and window size select hourly, daily, or whole-period results; optional selectors can narrow customer and metric scope. HTTP `200` requires top-level aggregate `data` and nullable sibling `next_page`, despite narrative wording that places the cursor inside aggregate objects. The endpoint has no `limit`, ordering, total count, cursor lifetime, stable snapshot, duplicate-or-skip, as-of, freshness, or read-after-ingest guarantee, so complete traversal does not prove an immutable or newly current reporting population. It returns usage quantities rather than prices, costs, invoice state, ledger state, or accounting-complete financial results. [[source-metronome-api-reference-usage-get-batched-usage-data]]
warnings: Preserve the narrative-versus-schema cursor-placement conflict and use the OpenAPI envelope plus example for integration shape.
The endpoint's analytics use cases do not make it financial-reporting, invoice, or accounting authority.
Keep endpoint-local absence of limit and ordering distinct from the separate pagination authority's general traversal guidance.

concepts.proposed_markdown: After events are accepted and matched to customers and billable metrics, bearer-authenticated `POST /v1/usage` can read aggregated post-metric usage across multiple customers and metrics by requested time windows. The page defines no read-after-ingest timing, freshness, stable snapshot, or completeness guarantee, so a completed batched traversal does not prove that every submitted event was accepted, deduplicated, matched, or made visible. Raw-event submission, transaction-ID deduplication, matching diagnostics, and ingest recovery remain with their dedicated authorities. [[source-metronome-api-reference-usage-get-batched-usage-data]]
warnings: Do not treat batched aggregate output as a raw-event receipt, deduplication record, per-event match result, or ingest recovery proof.
Keep transaction-ID behavior, event acceptance, and ingest failure handling with dedicated event-ingestion authorities.
